tei:div.tei:p: 315) ༄༅/ bsur mchod ye shes spring phung bzhugs so/ 316) om̐ ā hūm̐/ yum chen na bza' dkar mo'i mkha' dbyings kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i me thab chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ ye shes kyi me spungs dud sprin 'ja' tshon sna lnga rab tu 'khrig pa'i bseb nas/ mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ma la sogs pa re re las kyang sprul pa'i lha mo 'dod yon gyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa smad du byung ba nam mkha' rab 'byams 317) kyi mthar khyab pa ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'bul bar gyur/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pādh+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'di nyid/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dpal ldan rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams 318) mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo/ chos skyong bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho/ yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol zhing byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar phul bas mchod yul thams cad dgyes shing tshim nas thugs rje ye shes kyi 'od zer du 'ja' 'od kyi bseb tu 'phros pa las/ slar yang 'dod yon gyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs shing zad pa med pa byung ste/ khams gsum ris drug skye ba rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'gro sems can thams cad kyi mkho gu'i yo byad bza' btung gos rgyan gnas rten yul mkhar na ba'i gso sman skyabs mgon dpung gnyen la sogs pa gang la gang 'dod du gyur ste/

sems can mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bzang bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dam par gyur cig de ltar sbyin pa'i dge ba la brten nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad gnas skabs su lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang mthun rkyen thams cad gong du 'phel zhing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig
byang chub lam gyi cha rkyen du/ 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes pa kun bzang rig 'dzin bskul ngo ru bris pa'i gzhan phan mtha' yas shog bkra shis/ 320)
